Confirmed. The diagnosis is straightforward — **a database migration is missing from your Supabase instance**, the code is fine.

## What's happening

1. The consumer order-detail API (`src/app/api/consumer/orders/[id]/route.ts:25`) selects `collected_at`.
2. That column was added by `scripts/pickup-confirm-migration.sql`, which was **never run on Supabase**.
3. Supabase rejects the whole query → `column orders.collected_at does not exist` → the API returns 500 → the browser's `fetch` to the route surfaces as `TypeError: fetch failed`.

The `collected_at` column is part of the self-pickup handover-confirmation feature (the farmer's pickup-confirm flow at `confirm-pickup/route.ts` also writes to it), so the whole feature is silently broken until the column exists.

## The fix

Run this in **Supabase Dashboard → SQL Editor → New Query → Run** (it's safe and idempotent):

```sql
ALTER TABLE orders ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS collected_at timestamptz;

COMMENT ON COLUMN orders.collected_at IS
  'When a self-pickup order was confirmed collected by the farmer (handover code matched).';
```

That's the entire contents of `scripts/pickup-confirm-migration.sql`. Once it runs, the order-detail page will load and the pickup-confirmation timeline step will work.

You can paste it directly, or copy from the file. Since I can't reach your Supabase instance from here, you'll need to run it yourself (or paste it via `! ` if you have `psql` wired up).

Want me to also check whether any **other** recently-added migrations are at risk of the same gap? Several feature branches added columns (refunds, delivery, moderator), and if those weren't applied you'll hit the same error on other pages.

export async function generateMetadata({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {

  const { data: farmer } = await supabase
    .from('farmers')
    .select('id, name, village, district, story_quote')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .single()

  if (!farmer) return { title: 'Farmer not found' }

  const { data: firstPhoto } = await supabase
    .from('media')

    .limit(1)
    .single()

  const title = `${farmer.name} — Natural farmer in ${farmer.village}`
  const description =
    farmer.story_quote ??
    `Buy natural produce directly from ${farmer.name}, ${farmer.village}, ${farmer.district}. No middlemen. No chemicals.`

  return {

export default async function FarmerPage({ params }: { params: Promise<{ slug: string }> }) {
  const { slug } = await params

  const { data: farmer } = await supabase
    .from('farmers')
    .select('*')
    .eq('slug', slug)
    .eq('active', true)
    .single()

  if (!farmer) notFound()

  const { data: produce } = await supabase
    .from('produce_listings')
    .select('*')
    .eq('farmer_id', farmer.id)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })

  const { data: reviews } = await supabase
    .from('reviews')
    .select('*')
    .eq('farmer_id', farmer.id)
    .eq('approved', true)
    .order('created_at', { ascending: false })

  const { data: media } = await supabase
    .from('media')
    .select('*')
    .eq('farmer_id', farmer.id)
    .order('sort_order', { ascending: true })

  return (
    <main className="min-h-screen bg-gray-50 pb-24">
      <TopNav regionSlug={farmer.region_slug} />
      <FarmCover farmer={farmer} />
      <TrustStrip farmer={farmer} produceCount={produce?.length ?? 0} />
      <Suspense fallback={null}>
        <TabSection
          farmer={farmer}
          produce={produce ?? []}
          reviews={reviews ?? []}
          media={media ?? []}
        />
      </Suspense>
      <CartFab />
    </main>
  )
}
